Home.title: Time Series Intelligence Viewer
Home.subtitle: Interactive analysis surface for market history, forecast quality and benchmark context.
Home.status: The application is running. The viewer is focused on market analysis and forecast interpretation.

RawDataView.workspaceSubtitle: Select a component and analysis range.
RawDataView.forecastAccuracyInfoLine1: 1M compares the actual reading with the forecast prepared one month earlier.
RawDataView.forecastAccuracyInfoLine2: 3M, 6M and 12M use older forecast snapshots prepared respectively 3, 6 or 12 months before the target month.
RawDataView.forecastUnavailableHint: Historical data stays available. Current forecast could not be loaded for the selected model right now.
RawDataView.verificationUnavailableHint: Historical data and current forecast stay available. Historical forecast verification could not be loaded right now.
RawDataView.forecastTargetBasisInfoLine1: Target basis defines whether the forecast refers to a monthly average or an end-of-period reading.
RawDataView.forecastTargetBasisInfoLine2: Changing the basis changes the meaning of Current Forecast, Historical Forecast, Historical Actual and the verification delta.
RawDataView.forecastPortfolioSubtitle: Standalone review surface for one benchmark with historical actuals, current forecast, and historical forecast verification.
RawDataView.verificationHorizonInfoLine1: Horizon defines how early the forecast was prepared relative to the target month.
RawDataView.verificationHorizonInfoLine2: 1M, 3M, 6M and 12M do not change the target basis or model. They only change when the forecast snapshot was taken.
RawDataView.forecastVerificationDeltaInfoLine1: The ribbon shows the difference between Historical Forecast and the lawful Historical Actual for the selected target basis.
RawDataView.forecastVerificationDeltaInfoLine2: A positive delta means the forecast was above the actual. A negative delta means the forecast was below the actual.
RawDataView.forecastHorizonInfoBody: 1M compares the actual reading with the forecast that was made one month earlier. 3M and 6M use older forecast snapshots for that same target month.
RawDataView.historicalForecastUnavailableHint: Historical forecast data is not available for this benchmark. You can still use the percentage difference view.
RawDataView.historicalForecastErrorHint: Historical forecast data could not be loaded right now. You can retry or keep using the percentage difference view.
RawDataView.benchmarkRequired: This component has multiple benchmarks. Pick one before rendering the chart.
RawDataView.chartNeedsBenchmark: Select a benchmark to draw the chart for this component.
RawDataView.chartEmpty: No data is available for the current chart selection.
RawDataView.detailEmpty: Select a chart point to inspect the business detail panel.

variantSummaries.finderEmbeddedV2: Current chart-first benchmark experience with embedded host compatibility.
variantSummaries.forecastPortfolioV3: First standalone forecast portfolio proposal combining Historical Actual, Current Forecast, and Historical Forecast Verification.
